detail: Full summary: Empirical confirmation independent of the subagent's own report: a subagent dispatched to record into the harness store wrote nothing to EITHER store — harness newest decision record still dated Aug 3, twining-mcp newest was the parent session's own. It also never returned a report, emitting only idle notifications, so its stop-on-wrong-routing instruction cannot be credited for the clean outcome; treat 'no misfiling occurred' as verified by direct inspection of both stores, not by the agent's compliance.
